name: What Blooms in the Dark
source:
What Blooms in the Dark is a visual novel about an alien starship captain and his first mate, who are stuck in a cave with their unspoken feelings for each other.

[From [url=https://pocketcosmic.itch.io/what-blooms-in-the-dark]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《黑暗中盛开的花朵》是一部视觉小说，讲述了一位外星飞船船长和他的大副，他们被困在一个洞穴里，彼此之间有着难以言表的感情。

[来自[url=https://pocketcosmic.itch.io/what-blooms-in-the-dark]Itch.io[/url]]
